notes.title: Can't Stop Reframing!
notes.content: [p]​Hello! It's time for a September update! To those who got back to school, [strike]my sincere condolences[/strike] I wish you have a great year at school and have lots of fun![/p][p align="start"][b]​TL;DR[/b]: the game is being worked on! We've earned 2,000+ wishlists and 1200+ players! Will likely release the full game at around 7,000 wishlists.[/p][p align="start"]So what's the status for Reframe? It's being worked on! As of now, I've already made lots of progress on the 2nd chapter. In fact, yesterday's sudden burst of inspiration gave me some cool ideas on the final chapter content. I have no idea how many chapters there'll be, but probably 3 or 4. Here's a little recap on what's been made since the release of the demo, excluding already playable stuff that was added to the demo:[/p][p align="start"]- Added more than 10 new locations. None of them are 100% finished, but it's fine. In case you didn't know, the 2nd chapter will take place in a village just a few kilometers from the city! You'll get to spend the night in an old mystery house, take a tour and look at various artifacts found in the village, visit an abandoned summer camp, and... And much more![/p][p align="start"]- Added 2 hangouts with Lera. Will add (one?) more! If hangouts with Alina left you in shambles, the happy and outgoing Lera will probably cheer you up. You'll go to the movies, attempt to sneak in without paying (unsuccessfully), play video games, chase cats, and more! I'm gonna add more hangouts with other characters. Next up will probably be Pauline. I've decided to cut down on the number of locations, but instead fill each and every one with cool content. Speaking of cool content...[/p][p align="start"]- Added the COOLEST MISSION EVER! Well, it's not finished, but the fundamentals and scripts are mostly done. In the third App Trouble mission, you'll assist Danila in helping him defend his awesome app presentation from Grisha's evil hacks! Or you can help Grisha instead and ignore the attacks, letting him ruin the presentation... However, you'll soon realize that there are much bigger forces at play and Grisha is far from your biggest enemy... SPEAKING OF ENEMIES...[/p][p align="start"]- Added 3 new enemies! You may be great at beating thugs and alcoholics, but can you beat a security guard, a possessed puppet, or a robot that REALLY likes to give you riddles? [/p][p align="start"]- Added the 2nd chapter quests. So, the way I work on the game is, I make an extremely basic playable version of the questline with broken scripts and very rough layouts, and then gradually add detail, dialogue, and improvements. The chapter 2 plot is already mostly written, but there's still so much work to be done.[/p][p align="start"]- Emailed 50 creators, made several promotional videos and reddit posts! This one probably made you yawn, and I totally understand. Marketing is not very exciting, especially for a player. The reason I'm putting this here is because it's really important and a significant chunk of my time goes into marketing. I wish I didn't have to do it, but oh, well.[/p][p align="start"]But enough sadness! Because guess what! We just reached 2,000 wishlists on Steam! How cool is that!? And 1,216 extremely epic people have played the demo! Right now, I've decided to aim for 7,000 wishlists before launch. With 7,000 wishlists, we have a great chance to get into the magical "popular upcoming" section on Steam. And if we do... god, that will be beautiful. Since the 7,000 wishlists goal is feasible and free promotion is always great, I decided to go for it. According to my calculations, I should get there in about a year.[/p][p align="start"]So optimistically: May, 2026.[/p][p align="start"]Realistically: September, 2026.[/p][p align="start"]And conservatively: 2027. [/p][p align="start"]So does this mean the game will release in 2026? Maybe. Not sure:( Things might change. I'll continue posting more updates at least once a month! Thank you for being here![/p]

notes.title: Reframe Just Got Reframed (+teaser?)
notes.content:
[p]Just posted an update! Look at all those amazing features! Some of these I implemented a bit earlier, but I'll still mention them here because that's how awesome they are:[/p][list][*][p]Reframed the West Park area. It's not final, but I think it looks a little better. I'll keep improving it.[/p][/*][*][p]Reframed that little area to the east of Riverside. [/p][/*][*][p]Ref... Okay, I'm done with the joke. Reworked the drive to snowboarding cutscene.[/p][/*][*][p]After the theater cutscene, you're now given money that'll help you get back home safely.[/p][/*][*][p]Fighting the gazebo gopniks sometimes crashed the game. Not anymore.[/p][/*][*][p]Theater had a wall missing. I retrieved it and now you can't go out of bounds, even if you really want to.[/p][/*][*][p]Bleeding is now capped at 10% (down from 15%). We only have so much blood, after all.[/p][/*][*][p]Now you only lose SOME of your money when robbed! Gopniks are good at math and have some morals, so they'll each take 50% of your money on Normal, 25% on Easy and 10% on Super Easy difficulty. [/p][/*][*][p]Except vapers, vapers are greedy. They'll take all your money. Totally not because I forgot to apply the new logic to them.[/p][/*][*][p]The party is now shorter! But not for everyone.[/p][/*][/list][p]
Almost forgot... Here's a tiny little teaser from the next chapter. You can't see anything, I know. It's what the darkness does. Spooky stuff ahead! Of course, I added more than just a dark corridor and a flashlight. I'm not yet ready to share it yet, but I will, soon. For free! And I hope you'll be there to see it!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565707/9e29bfd5e3c52a756aaf268e2863634c08a49df2.png"][/img]
Wishlist the game now! And if you haven't played yet... I mean, Play it? It's free. It has cats. And my soul. Not literally, but you get the idea.[/p]

notes.title: Reframe on Next Fest + Patreon Launch
notes.content: [h2][b]Hi everyone![/b][/h2][p]It's already almost two weeks since I released the free demo for [b]Reframe[/b]. Crazy! AND we just reached 100 members on our Discord! That's awesome![/p][p]First of all, thank you all so much for playing! It really means a lot to me. The launch day was really nerve-racking to me as I really had no idea if my game was any good. You know, I really tried hard, but I couldn't know for sure.[/p][p]Thankfully, seeing you folks play, discover secrets, strategies, sharing your thoughts has reassured me that this silly dream of mine has a chance. Let's talk a little bit about some results and what happens next![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565707/cf0bce1bd15184e3e7bda4145e581f2871f86ea9.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Steam stats[/b].[/h2][p]Looking at Steam's stats, at least [b]246[/b] people have downloaded and played the demo. Which is good! I'm really happy with those numbers, and we're just getting started! The median playtime fluctuates around 35 minutes, which is... As far as I could tell, it's pretty good? What really blew my mind though is the average playtime which is already at 2.5 hours. That's huge! Wow.[/p][p]5% of players played for more than 10 hours and 1% of players played for over 20 hours. That is also amazing. Looks like the demo really turned out pretty huge. It can take as little as 2 hours to beat when only doing the main questline, but it can take over 10 hours to 100%.[/p][p]Once again, thank you all so much for playing and sharing your feedback! [/p][p][/p][h2][b]What now[/b]?[/h2][p]Steam Next Fest on June, 9th! It's a Steam event where game devs share their demos. As far as I could tell, we can find lots of new players as every game will get a decent amount of exposure. That's the hope, at least. Then we'll see! But before that, I have to make an announcement that I wasn't sure I wanted to make.[/p][p]See, this channel's success got me pretty confident. It gave me a once in a lifetime opportunity to take a shot at making my biggest dream come true. It supported me financially for a long time. But it is no longer the case. Whether I fell off or just upset the algorithms, I don't know. But, see, I can no longer rely on this channel to be my main source of income.[/p][p]Long gone are the days when all I needed money for is gaming. Now I have to pay rent, pay for food, pay for... Everything! Even subscriptions to all sorts of programs that I need to make videos and make the game. This is why I now have a [url="https://patreon.com/reframe_dev"]Patreon[/url] page! [/p][p][/p][h2][b]Why though[/b]?[/h2][p]First and foremost, this Patreon page will allow me to confidently continue the development of Reframe! I [i]really [/i]can't do it without you guys... The development of the game is a full-time commitment. If I got a job again, the development of Reframe will probably take over a decade, if not longer. I really want the development of the game to be my sole focus for the next few years, and this will allow me to do just that![/p][p][/p][h2][b]Why should I donate[/b]?[/h2][p]But supporting the development is one thing! Even with the lowest tier subscription, you'll get access to some of my behind-the-scenes content (not, like, [b]now[/b], but it will be there in the future!), screenshots of the progress, detailed devlogs and much more! Of course, all of this will [i]eventually [/i]become available to everyone for free, but being a subscriber will allow you to be among the first to see it all with your own eyes![/p][p]Also, subscribing will give you some special Discord perks! A new shiny [b]Supporter Cat[/b] role and, if you're a guy named Jeff, a super ultra mega powerful[b]⚡Ultra Cat⚡[/b] role! Please only donate if you can afford it! I totally understand if you don't have money to spare in this economy.[/p][p]If you can't donate but you liked the game and want to help it thrive, please consider spreading the word about the game or telling about it to your favorite YouTubers. No pressure though:)[/p][p]Thank you!! [/p][p][url="https://patreon.com/reframe_dev"]Patreon[/url][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/UvtdsDYMmz"]Discord[/url][/p][p][/p]
